== What changed on the image ==
[[File:CC-L-landocalrissian-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Lando Calrissian (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): The game text changes: “Falcon” is now set in italics. The slip prints POWER 2 again. The black strip has only the white italic “E”, no title.

The 2013 slip and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
